project.name: python-booker-webhook
project.description: Austrian embassy appointment booker webhook (FastAPI + Playwright). An n8n + Python pipeline that watches appointment slots, solves BotDetect captchas via OCR/Gemini, and books appointments on the BMEIA portal. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The Austrian appointment system: an n8n + Python pipeline that watches embassy slots, solves BotDetect captchas, and books appointments on the BMEIA portal. Start with the agent guide.

tour.title: Booking Webhook Entry Point
tour.description: FastAPI app exposing POST /webhook/booker; it receives turbo booking payloads and orchestrates the OCR/Gemini/Playwright pipeline.

tour.title: Playwright Booking Core
tour.description: The legacy Playwright engine that drives the BMEIA site: navigation, form filling, and captcha submission.

tour.title: Captcha & Scheduler Parsing
tour.description: OCR client captures the BotDetect captcha image; scheduler_html parses available appointment slots from the BMEIA HTML.

tour.title: n8n Orchestration
tour.description: n8n watcher and booker workflows that enqueue slots and trigger the webhook with booking payloads.

tour.title: Dev Tools & Sandboxes
tour.description: Debugging scripts and isolated sandboxes used to exercise the OCR API and harvest captcha images for fine-tuning.

tour.title: Tests & Validation
tour.description: Unit and integration tests covering slot selection, scheduler parsing, submit-error classification, and the captcha pipeline.

tour.title: Configuration
tour.description: Dependency manifests and environment configuration that tune runtime and captcha-solver behavior.
